row.notes: Gamedb loader for one game-setup mode row (ref = two 0x100 char bufs, joined as table.label). Step 1: <mode>.session_collection row0 -> its 'session' rows; reads standings (-> game_setup.session_standings / session_standing_preset stat_id, ptr = g_Game_Scenarios+0xe8 + id*0x20), session_id and session_to_apply_penalties_to (both matched by strcmp against the 19-entry session-name table at 0x1457cb7e0), pushes 16-byte {standings ptr, session type, penalty session type} into vector out+0x8/+0x10/+0x18 unless that session type is already present. Step 2: <mode>.session_group_collection row0 -> three near-identical passes over practice_session_group, qualifying_session_group, race_session_group, appended to vectors at out+0x28, out+0x48, out+0x68 (elem 0x38: +0 group enum 1-5 by FNV-1a64 lowercase hash of field 'group', +0x10 vector of length groupings, +0x28 '<row>.type' enum 1-5 by hash, +0x29 '<row>.ruleset' via 0x140b02290 default 0x10, +0x2c '<row>.grid_type' and +0x30 '<row>.grid_type_no_qualifying' via 0x1413d4260 default -1). Each group also walks <row>.practice_session_length_grouping (race pass uses race_session_len..., qualifying analog): 'available_in' labels -> game_setup.weekend_options.practice_lengths/practice_length_option (race: ...race_lengths/race_length_option) stat_id (<16, else fatal 0x142b16e50) OR-ed into a bitmask minus bits claimed by earlier groupings, 'sessions' names -> session type ints; elem 0x28 {+0 mask u32, +0x10 int vector}. Strings are XOR-decoded in place with k_Gdb_StringXorKey. Good hook to see or alter which sessions a weekend format contains per session-length option. Read fully for the standings step and practice pass, start and end of the other two passes; the middle of the qualifying/race passes was checked by call sequence only.
